subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 land as the first opt-in round-based iteration budget, with total tool-call and post-first-tool timeout limits handled as follow-ups?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a round budget is feasible and correctly owned, but they cannot decide the permanent public config scope or user-visible exhaustion policy.

options.title: Land round budget first
options.body: Accept the proven opt-in round cap and track total-call and elapsed-time budgets as narrower follow-up work.

options.title: Require unified limits
options.body: Hold the PR until round, total tool-call, and elapsed-time limits share one public budget contract.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Keep whole-run timeout and pattern-based loop detection as the supported controls, closing both the issue and candidate PR by explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Land round budget first
recommendation.body: Accept the proven opt-in round cap and track total-call and elapsed-time budgets as narrower follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest available central-path history and already framed the issue’s remaining product-contract decision.
